name: Ma Maison ~Sunao ni Narenai Juunin-tachi~
original_name: マ・メゾン～素直になれない住人たち～
source:
Serene spring.... The main character has moved to an apartment. On his first day there, he meets a landlady, Kyoko. She is very beautiful, and he falls in love with her at once.... He gradually becomes friends with his neighbors as well, and....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090304202656/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1008074]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
宁静的春日…主人公搬进了一栋公寓。入住第一天，他遇见了房东Kyoko。她十分美丽，主人公一见钟情…渐渐地，他也和邻居们熟络起来，而后…
